title: Bounded CBOR decoding
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation. HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation: “all input fields MUST be properly validated by data types, lengths and contents”.

statements.label: Bounded CBOR decoding
statements.requirement: The CBOR decoder SHALL enforce configurable limits on nesting depth, item count and string/byte-string length, and SHALL reject malformed or truncated input with a typed error, without panicking or throwing unchecked exceptions.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-CBR-003 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-CBR-003 nesting beyond the limit is refused` (EncodeCborTest.kt)).
